title: CAISO: curtailment against midday prices
subtitle: Each point is a day, 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_curtailment_daily, iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-11-05.
citations: California ISO (CAISO). Daily Renewable Report (curtailment and output); Production and curtailments data (5-minute). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `caiso_curtailment_daily`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.

California Independent System Operator (CAISO); Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT); Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO); Southwest Power Pool (SPP). Historical RTM Load Zone and Hub Prices; OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute); RTBM LMP by Settlement Location, 5-minute; Real-Time Final Market LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `iso_rtm_hub_prices`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.
facts: CAISO, 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04 (30 days): the most curtailment in a day was 22573.12 MWh on 2026-10-14, when the mean midday real-time price at TH_NP15_GEN-APND was 40.38 USD/MWh; the correlation of daily curtailment with the midday price over these days was -0.03.
Wind and solar curtailed, 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-04: 35834.62 MWh.

xAxis.name: Wind and solar curtailed, MWh per day

yAxis.name: Mean real-time price 10:00 to 16:00 Pacific, USD/MWh
